note: Ranges are the Debian 13 (trixie) package's current major.minor. Point and security updates within that major.minor pass; moving to the next Debian release is a deliberate codename change. Each component affects the pin-built reference results, so an image build records the installed version and fails when it leaves its range. tkrzw must also pass tools/tkrzw/distro-probe.sh.

components.name: glibc
components.basis: trixie 13.7 libc6 2.41-12+deb13u4; the pin's fscanf %d/%f/%255s grammar and strtod behaviour are this libc's.

components.name: glib
components.basis: trixie 13.7 libglib2.0-0t64 2.84.4-3~deb13u5; GLib owns the pin's GArray, g_free and string helpers.

components.name: Berkeley DB 5.3
components.basis: trixie 13.7 libdb5.3t64 5.3.28+dfsg2-9; the bdb cell's on-disk format and cursor semantics.

components.name: Kyoto Cabinet
components.basis: trixie 13.7 libkyotocabinet16v5 1.2.80-2+b1; the kc cell's on-disk format and API.

components.name: tkrzw
components.basis: trixie 13.7 libtkrzw1t64 1.0.32-1+b1; the tkrzw cell's on-disk format and API, and the pointer-identity health check.

components.name: C compiler
components.basis: trixie 13.7 gcc-14 14.2.0-19; the compiler that builds the pin's shared objects.

components.name: C++ compiler
components.basis: trixie 13.7 g++-14 14.2.0-19; the compiler that builds the pin's shared objects.

components.name: binutils
components.basis: trixie 13.7 binutils 2.44-3; the assembler and linker that build the pin's shared objects.

components.name: autoconf
components.basis: trixie 13.7 autoconf 2.72-3.1; the autotools generation that builds the pin.

components.name: automake
components.basis: trixie 13.7 automake 1:1.17-4; the autotools generation that builds the pin.

components.name: libtool
components.basis: trixie 13.7 libtool 2.5.4-4; the autotools generation that builds the pin.

components.name: gettext
components.basis: trixie 13.7 gettext 0.23.1-2; provides autopoint, which autoreconf runs for the pin.

components.name: pkg-config
components.basis: trixie 13.7 pkg-config 1.8.1-4; resolves the pin's GLib and DBM build flags.
